stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard reassign [-h] [--to TO_BOSS] [--consent-from CONSENT]
                                  [--undo] [--from SENDER]
                                  worker

positional arguments:
  worker                The worker's fleet name

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --to TO_BOSS          The orchestrator that becomes its boss
  --consent-from CONSENT
                        The worker's CURRENT boss, whose consent is recorded
                        with this command
  --undo                Remove the override: the worker reports to the boss it
                        was launched with again
  --from SENDER         Lab only: the caller's fleet name
